answer_1.quote: Informative text summarization aims to shorten a long piece of text while preserving its main message.

answer_2.quote: We use three automatic evaluation metrics to evaluate our models. The first is ROUGE, the standard summarization quality metric... we use two additional automatic metrics that specifically focus on factual consistency: FactCC ... and QGQA.

answer_4.quote: We select three state-of-the-art abstractive summarization models as the backbones, and collect three sets of pairwise summaries... Three annotators from Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) are asked to judge which is more factually correct.
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise comparison of factual correctness; annotators choose which summary is Better, Worse, or Same in terms of factual correctness.
